class.name: SignalClient
class.brief_description: WebSocket client for the Blazium lobby and signaling protocol.
class.description: Speaks protocol v1 JSON envelopes to an example [code]blazium-signal[/code] service: rooms, SDP/ICE, fake addresses, and last-resort datagram relay. [WebRTCEnetSession] owns one of these. Game code can also use it to build other utilities against the same contract. This client never talks to TURN's internal session API.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets [code]ws://[/code] or [code]wss://[/code] URL, game namespace, and optional bearer token.

method.name: connect_to_signal
method.description: Opens the WebSocket. Sends [code]X-Game-Id[/code] and optional [code]Authorization[/code] headers.

method.name: is_open
method.description: True when the signaling WebSocket is open.

method.name: poll
method.description: Must be called regularly. [WebRTCEnetSession] does this from [method Node._process].

method.name: send_message
method.description: Sends a protocol v1 envelope [code]{ "v": 1, "type": type, "id": id, "data": data }[/code].

signal.name: disconnected
signal.description: The signaling WebSocket closed after having been open.

signal.name: message_received
signal.description: A parsed protocol envelope from the server.
